info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Manage Public Offering Details API
info.description: The Manage Public Offering Details API enables users to update key information related to public offerings in the corporate finance space. This endpoint targets adjustments such as modifying offering terms, pricing adjustments, and regulatory compliance updates. It is primarily designed for corporate finance professionals and institutions that need to maintain accurate, timely data for their public offerings. By leveraging this API, users can ensure that their offerings are up to date and compliant with relevant regulations.

patch.summary: Update details of a public offering.
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the information regarding a specific public offering identified by its resource ID. Ensure that the request body contains the necessary details to make the update.

requestBody.description: Updates details for the specified public offering. This request requires specific fields to be provided depending on the modifications required for the public offering identified by RES-100045.
